Service Interruption Definitions

Elevator

No Service Condition/Full Service Interruption: For a single-elevator building, disruption in elevator service preventing a resident from using the elevator to reach their floor or lobby. For a multiple-elevator building, disruption in elevator service simultaneously across all elevators preventing a resident from using the elevators to reach their floor or lobby.
Partial Service Interruption: Disruption in elevator service in one or more elevators in a multiple-elevator building. At least one elevator is in service allowing a resident to use an elevator to reach their floor or lobby.
REHAB is a Planned Outage caused by work done to rehabilitate the entire elevator car. This work occurs over a longer period such as few months.

Water

Development is without water service; building is without water service; or more than one unit in a development is without both kitchen and bathroom water service.

Heat

No heat service in an apartment line, stair hall*, building, or development

Electrical

Disruption in electrical service to an apartment line, stair hall*, building, or development.

Gas

Interruption of gas service in an apartment line, stair hall*, building, development or boiler room.

Sectional Outage Definition

A sectional outage occurs when multiple buildings at a development experience disruptions in heat or hot water services due to an issue with the shared line they are serviced by. Sectional outages do not affect all buildings at a development.

Service Interruption Status Definitions


NYCHA Staff and Vendor Assigned: NYCHA Staff and Vendor has been assigned to work on the issue

NYCHA Staff and Vendor Dispatched: NYCHA Staff and Vendor are on their way to the Development to work on the issue

NYCHA Staff and Vendor Working: NYCHA Staff and Vendor are working to fix the issue

NYCHA Staff Assigned: NYCHA Staff has been assigned to work on the issue

NYCHA Staff Dispatched: NYCHA Staff is on their way to the Development to work on the issue

NYCHA Staff Working: NYCHA Staff is working to fix the issue

Outage Reported: Outage has been reported

Referred to Service Provider: Outage has been verified and referred to utility company for assistance

Service Restored: Outage has been fixed

Vendor Assigned: Vendor has been assigned to work on the issue

Vendor Dispatched: Vendor is on their way to the Development to work on the issue

Vendor Working: Vendor is working to fix the issue

*A stair hall is an individual entrance in a building of a development
